story_text:
As a platform, I want eventual consistency across microservices so that order data is synchronized.

AC1: Order service publishes events to Kafka
AC2: Payment service consumes and processes payment
AC3: Notification service sends confirmation
AC4: Inventory service decrements stock
AC5: Compensation: failed payment rolls back order
AC6: Outbox pattern for reliable event publishing
architecture_text: Microservices with Kafka event bus. Each service has its own database. Outbox pattern for exactly-once delivery. Saga pattern for distributed transactions.

story_text:
As a user, I want search to return relevant results so that I can find what I'm looking for.

AC1: Full-text search on product name and description
AC2: Faceted filters: category, brand, price range
AC3: Sort by relevance, price, rating
AC4: Index refresh within 5 minutes of product change
AC5: Handle 1M products
AC6: Typo tolerance (Levenshtein distance 2)
architecture_text: Elasticsearch cluster with product index. Incremental indexing via Kafka consumer. Search API with query DSL. Synonym dictionary.
